decision.economic_authorization: None; this proposal is structural only.
decision.frontier_reasoning: Considered the complete current 1,576-identity frontier and all 10 open mechanism families. Do not revisit completed-family diagnostics; carry/term-structure remains blocked by unresolved metadata authority. The selected family uses existing accepted history and tests a distinct mechanism.
decision.method: Before examining results, freeze one low-complexity causal model, past-only feature and label timing, chronological out-of-sample evaluation, time-clustered inference, and family-wide multiplicity control. Do not tune on observed diagnostics, reuse their outputs as inputs, rank symbols, or promote an economic experiment.
decision.scope: Use all 41 current structural representatives, selected by signature coverage rather than observed outcomes. Treat representatives as structural breadth, not economic equivalence.

next_research_state.implementation_scope: Create the prospective freeze and deterministic evaluator for the specified fixed, low-complexity causal predictive-state screen on the 41 current structural representatives. Enforce past-only inputs, chronological out-of-sample evaluation, time-clustered inference, family-wide multiplicity control, and no parameter tuning or economic evaluation. Reuse accepted M5 history; do not introduce new market data or rerun prior-family diagnostics.

objective.goal: Test whether a small, fixed causal predictive-state model yields stable out-of-sample directional information across the current structural frontier.
objective.information_gain_rationale: The eligible frontier contains 1,576 identities represented by 41 distinct structural signatures, with accepted 13-week M5 history for all 41 representatives. A separately frozen, low-complexity predictive-state hypothesis can probe a distinct open family without reopening consumed identities or redesigning a prior family diagnostic.
